w: Swamishri, during his address to the youths of Kisumu, advised, "It was the wish of Yogiji Maharaj that if the youths are awake and wedded to Satsang then there will be a better society. You must remember that whatever you do in Satsang is to please Shriji Maharaj and for one’s salvation and not for praise or appreciation... Yogiji Maharaj gave the formula of unity and harmony. If you have harmony, friendliness and unity then you can accomplish whatever work you wish... Here in Satsang the fruits of a minor or major seva are the same. Firstly, if your faith and observance of moral codes is firm and unswerving then others will have trust in you. Secondly, you should attend the weekly Sunday assembly, do your puja daily, come for mandir darshan and regularly read the Vachanamrit and Swami ni Vato..."

The whole world needs harmony, friendliness and unity. (Samp, Suhradbhav, Ekta). Every person needs it. Politics needs it and society too needs it. And we especially need it because we have come for moksha.
One should have an eye for glory (mahima). If someone scolds you then don’t bring it to mind. Say sorry or Jay Swaminarayan and like a line in water, forget it.

Success lies in having single faith and refuge in God and doing whatever the holy sadhu says. The Pandavas faced insurmountable difficulties and obstacles but still they survived and were redeemed. They triumphed in the Mahabharat war and earned the grace of God.
Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha at the Shree Swaminarayan Mandir, Clifton.

In the evening assembly a memorable program by children was performed before an audience of 16,000 devotees. Firstly, a saga of outstanding children of the Bal Mandal was narrated. It reflected the effect of Satsang on their moral, social and academic performances. Then young children chanted the dhun and told Swamishri to play the dholak and chant the dhun. This was followed by an impressive monoacting presentation on the story of Magniram. The children also took the opportunity of playing 'ras' with Swamishri and then performed arti and offered thal to Thakorji. Finally, the program was crowned with Swamishri's blessings.

Bal/Balika Din After the presentation by balaks in the evening satsang assembly, Swamishri blessed the audience, “Our true wealth is that our children imbibe good virtues and spirituality. For this the parents have to be extremely alert. There should be a mandir in the home. But nowadays there is a TV instead of a mandir. And they watch that which should not be watched. They sit together and watch. Then how will respect (for elders) remain? With this loss of respect, the family is destroyed. One sees all this, yet one does not think to stop. Only when one understands this and practices it will one experience happiness.”

The 221st birthday anniversary of Gunatitanand Swami was celebrated in the mandir hall. The celebration assembly was themed on the importance of Gunatitanand Swami’s presence on earth. Speeches on Gunatitanand Swami as an ideal sadhu, an inspirer of God-realization in devotees, and the promoter of supreme upasana were made by sadhus. Thereafter a drama, “Abhaysinh’s Resoluteness”, was performed in Swamishri’s presence. Viveksagar Swami discoursed about the eternal presence of the Gunatit Sadhu. Then the youths of Mumbai performed a traditional dance. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly, “Shriji Maharaj said that he had come on earth with his abode, Gunatit. He brought his abode with him because he wanted all to attain the gunatit state – free of all desires – and liberate them from root-ignorance. It is because of body-consciousness (dehbhav) that one remains ignorant. Till one does not realize one’s original form (i.e. One must perform one’s worldly duties, but one’s mind should be engaged in God.” At 7.45 pm Swamishri performed the celebration arti.
